verdict.rationale: OpenClaw provides a documented `exec` tool that is explicitly a 'mutating shell surface' able to create, edit, or delete files on the host/sandbox filesystem, plus sandboxing modes to control blast radius, and community testimony (openclaw-comm-1, openclaw-comm-4) confirms real hands-on file/command execution (with comm-4 noting root-equivalent access, underscoring it's a genuine exec surface, not just chat). This goes well beyond chat — it's a real, agentic command/file-edit surface. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmark of exec reliability/safety and more granular documentation of file-edit guarantees beyond shell commands.
